title: com.google.cloud plugin extension
description: Google-owned extension namespace embedded in an Agent Plugin spec plugin.json. Holds the single source of truth used by agent-plugin-sync to derive the harness-specific manifests (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity). Fields are neutral wherever a value is shared across harnesses; harness-shaped pockets carry the few bits that have no neutral meaning.

comment.description: Free-form note. Ignored by the generator.

config.description: Neutral list of user-supplied configuration variables. Derived into Gemini `settings` and Claude `userConfig`.

gemini.description: Gemini-only bits with no neutral equivalent.

contextFileName.description: Markdown context file loaded by Gemini CLI (e.g. POSTGRESQL.md).

mcpServerName.description: Key used for this plugin's server in the generated gemini-extension.json `mcpServers`. Defaults to the first server name in mcp.json.

key.description: Environment variable name, e.g. POSTGRES_HOST. Used verbatim by Gemini; lowercased for Claude userConfig keys.

description.description: One-line explanation shown in each harness's config UI.

required.description: Whether the user must supply a value. Defaults to false.

default.description: Default value when the user leaves it unset.

sensitive.description: Whether the value is a secret (e.g. a password). Defaults to false.
